title: The Midnight Wedding
text: A contract surfaces, signed by your House three generations ago, promising one of its children in marriage at midnight to a groom from beyond the Gate. The groom has arrived. He is very tall, and he waits in the courtyard without moving.

options.label: Honor the contract and give him a child of the House, as your forebears swore.

outcomes.text: The vows are spoken in a language none of you know. The Scion returns at dawn wearing a ring of black iron, with a stranger's patience.
The vows are spoken. The Scion returns at dawn, and at night they talk in their sleep in his voice.

options.label: Dress a recruit in the bridal veil, and pray he does not look beneath it.

outcomes.text: He takes the recruit's hand without looking under the veil. Neither is seen again.
He lifts the veil and looks for a long time, then leaves. The courtyard stones are frozen where he stood.

options.label: Tear the contract up in front of him; no child of the House goes beyond the Gate.

outcomes.text: He bows very low and goes back the way he came. In old mouths, the House's name weighs a little less.
He goes. The next morning, every mirror in the Seat is cracked.
